    The D̃₄ star #

    Four morphisms out of one object, none factoring through another and none divisible by τ, form a cleaving D̃₄ star in P/τ. Hence a minimal representation-infinite P has no such four morphisms (RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_four_out; BO13a, Lemma 6: "at most three arrows start at x").
